verdict.rationale: The axis applies to this kind of product — every other product in the arena is judged on it, including Omnara, the closest orchestration-layer peer, which holds 'none' — and Superset's evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the user's own data. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability is 'none', not 'na' (harmonized at the 2026-09-25 bring-up; omnara precedent).
